cohort: Pregnant women with 1 or more prior CDs that received a US diagnosis of placenta previa or low-lying placenta in the third trimester
finding: The Placenta Accreta Index (PAI) is a useful tool for the prenatal prediction of PAS in women with prior cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: With a threshold of greater than 4, the PAI has a sensitivity of 87%, specificity of 77%, positive predictive value of 72%, and negative predictive value of 90% for PAS diagnosis.
